decisions.title: Docker-first runtime
decisions.context: A small cluster needs a concrete execution API.
decisions.observed_implementation: Docker Runtime interface and Engine adapter provide pull/create/start/inspect/stop/remove operations; FakeRuntime serves deterministic tests.
decisions.inferred_costs: Agent socket access is highly privileged; Docker behavior still needs real integration tests.
decisions.failure_scenario: Create succeeds but the status response is lost; inspect labels before creating another container.
decisions.boundary: Adapter coverage does not establish isolation or resource fields from every caller.
decisions.teaching_design_validation_plan: Build a separately tested constrained adapter; compare actual DTO fields and real HostConfig.
decisions.rationale_classification: editorial inference; no author motivation attributed

decisions.title: Polling and reporting agents
decisions.context: Workers need assignments and control plane needs observations.
decisions.observed_implementation: Agent loop fetches assignments, executes runtime actions and reports task/heartbeat state.
decisions.inferred_benefits: Small HTTP protocol and retryable observation loop.
decisions.inferred_costs: A lost report acknowledgement can be retried; stale reports require lifecycle checks.
decisions.failure_scenario: Partitioned worker can keep serving while a new task is assigned elsewhere.
decisions.boundary: No worker fencing protocol follows merely from polling.
decisions.teaching_design_validation_plan: Use explicit generations and test stale-report rejection independently.
decisions.rationale_classification: editorial inference; no author motivation attributed

decisions.title: Go packages and injected dependencies
decisions.context: Algorithms should be testable without an Engine or database.
decisions.observed_implementation: Schedulers/controllers accept interfaces; package tests use explicit stores, fake runtime and injected clocks.
decisions.alternatives: single monolithic loop or remote service per subsystem
decisions.inferred_benefits: Deterministic code navigation and narrow test fixtures.
decisions.inferred_costs: An implemented package may have no caller in main; test success does not activate it.
decisions.failure_scenario: A package test passes while a live binary uses a different path.
decisions.teaching_design_validation_plan: Maintain a constructor/caller ledger alongside package coverage.
decisions.rationale_classification: editorial inference; no author motivation attributed

decisions.title: Memory-backed executable composition
decisions.context: Executable construction decides where authoritative state lives.
decisions.observed_implementation: Default server constructs MemoryService with secret-envelope option and passes it to API/controllers.
decisions.inferred_costs: State maps disappear on new process startup; nearby PostgreSQL does not alter this.
decisions.failure_scenario: Fresh server loses services/node identity while old Docker containers may survive.
decisions.boundary: No default binary durability or HA claim.
decisions.teaching_design_validation_plan: Design a separate shared-store composition and prove restart behavior with new processes.
decisions.rationale_classification: editorial inference; no author motivation attributed

decisions.title: PostgreSQL transactional store
decisions.context: Shared state changes need atomic checks and versions.
decisions.observed_implementation: Store contains transactional operations and AssignTask with state/version predicates.
decisions.alternatives: in-memory locks or event-sourced durable journal
decisions.inferred_benefits: Database atomic update/rejection can be tested independently.
decisions.inferred_costs: Store library remains separate from MemoryService-backed binary; schema fixtures cover differing subsets.
decisions.failure_scenario: Two operators claim or update the same stale object.
decisions.boundary: Atomic package behavior is not executable durable state ownership.
decisions.teaching_design_validation_plan: Run guarded throwaway integration tests and wire no application changes in this edition.
decisions.rationale_classification: editorial inference; no author motivation attributed

decisions.title: Desired versus actual lifecycle
decisions.context: Intent and observed execution arrive asynchronously.
decisions.observed_implementation: Task model and transition guards distinguish desired state from allowed agent reports.
decisions.alternatives: single status field or synchronous deployment RPC
decisions.inferred_benefits: State writers and illegal resurrection are explicit.
decisions.inferred_costs: Several legal shortcut transitions exist; a simplified diagram is only a subset.
decisions.failure_scenario: A late running report arrives after desired stopped.
decisions.boundary: Accepted state reports do not prove physical remote action.
decisions.teaching_design_validation_plan: Record generation/time ownership and test late responses at real HTTP boundaries.
decisions.rationale_classification: editorial inference; no author motivation attributed

decisions.title: Deterministic planning versus active placement
decisions.context: Repeatable resource/label/port decisions are useful only on the path used.
decisions.observed_implementation: Scheduler.Plan computes assignments; MemoryService normal replica reconciliation directly creates assigned tasks.
decisions.alternatives: call pure planner in all paths or keep independent paths
decisions.inferred_benefits: Pure planner can be property-tested without side effects.
decisions.inferred_costs: Its resource guarantees cannot be transferred to MemoryService service placement.
decisions.failure_scenario: A node advertised below requests still receives tasks on the active service path.
decisions.boundary: Planner correctness is a package guarantee.
decisions.teaching_design_validation_plan: Constrained comparative fixture uses identical service/node intent on both paths.
decisions.rationale_classification: editorial inference; no author motivation attributed

decisions.title: Optimistic concurrency
decisions.context: Controllers and operators race on stale snapshots.
decisions.observed_implementation: Store operations carry expected UpdatedAt/version predicates and distinguish assignment conflicts.
decisions.alternatives: coarse global locking or serial command log
decisions.inferred_benefits: Rejects stale write attempts where guarded.
decisions.inferred_costs: Every relevant write must participate; timestamps and versions are not a fencing token.
decisions.failure_scenario: Concurrent rollout and scale read the same old service.
decisions.boundary: Memory locking and PostgreSQL transactions have different scopes.
decisions.teaching_design_validation_plan: Add two-writer stale-update experiment, record returned errors and surviving state.
decisions.rationale_classification: editorial inference; no author motivation attributed

decisions.title: Request-scoped namespaces
decisions.context: Same-name workloads and credentials need scoped lookup.
decisions.observed_implementation: Namespace selection travels in context/header and scoped collection filters.
decisions.alternatives: one cluster per tenant or separate databases
decisions.inferred_costs: Isolation must be traced route by route; authentication alone is insufficient.
decisions.failure_scenario: Operator selects one namespace but follows an unscoped lookup.
decisions.boundary: This is application scoping, not network or kernel tenant isolation.
decisions.teaching_design_validation_plan: Create same-name services in distinct test contexts and inspect each exposed API path.
decisions.rationale_classification: editorial inference; no author motivation attributed

decisions.title: Local storage and topology
decisions.context: Local data belongs to a particular node.
decisions.observed_implementation: Volume/claim and attachment models exist; workload placement and agent propagation require separate inspection.
decisions.alternatives: shared network storage or stateless service
decisions.inferred_benefits: Explicit topology and straightforward local fixtures.
decisions.inferred_costs: A claim object does not make disks replicated or automatically attachable elsewhere.
decisions.failure_scenario: Node loss leaves local data unavailable on replacement node.
decisions.teaching_design_validation_plan: Separate local directory fixture; test unsupported propagation without user host mounts.
decisions.rationale_classification: editorial inference; no author motivation attributed

decisions.title: Node-scoped published host ports
decisions.observed_implementation: Service ports and scheduler allocation model node-level published ports; Docker adapter creates port bindings.
decisions.alternatives: service mesh/virtual IP or externally assigned load balancer
decisions.inferred_costs: Fixed ports collide on one node; dynamic port identity changes and bindings may expose all interfaces.
decisions.failure_scenario: Scale two replicas onto the same fixed published port.
decisions.boundary: Package reservation is not cluster-wide data-plane routing.
decisions.teaching_design_validation_plan: Test collision with a fake first; use isolated daemon for actual wildcard bindings.
decisions.rationale_classification: editorial inference; no author motivation attributed

decisions.title: Optional ingress configuration
decisions.context: External routes need discovered backend endpoints.
decisions.observed_implementation: Traefik config package builds provider configuration and default server exposes the integration endpoint.
decisions.alternatives: manual reverse proxy or no ingress
decisions.inferred_costs: Upstream demo insecure dashboard is disposable; overlay design is not implemented networking.
decisions.failure_scenario: API endpoint is healthy while proxy backend list is stale.
decisions.boundary: No overlay or tenant network isolation follows.
decisions.teaching_design_validation_plan: Validate generated config and compare endpoint selection; bind demo admin listener to loopback.
decisions.rationale_classification: editorial inference; no author motivation attributed

decisions.title: Interfaces versus plugin roadmap
decisions.context: Engine, secret and controller seams allow controlled experiments.
decisions.observed_implementation: Go interfaces permit compiled adapters; plugin design documentation proposes broader extension behavior.
decisions.alternatives: dynamic runtime loading or external webhooks
decisions.inferred_benefits: Small teaching extension can be isolated and tested.
decisions.inferred_costs: A design document or interface is not a functioning plugin distribution system.
decisions.failure_scenario: An operator expects a configured external plugin to load in main.
decisions.boundary: Plugin system is design-only where no runtime loader exists.
decisions.teaching_design_validation_plan: Implement teaching adapter under examples, never in immutable source.
decisions.rationale_classification: editorial inference; no author motivation attributed

decisions.title: GitOps apply and bookkeeping
decisions.context: Several manifests form one desired change but current operations are sequential.
decisions.observed_implementation: GitOps controller applies parsed manifests through a control-plane interface and records synchronization/ownership state.
decisions.alternatives: preflight complete batch then transactional commit or best-effort explicit per-file results
decisions.inferred_costs: The valid first manifest may remain changed when a later one fails; metadata can lag side effects.
decisions.failure_scenario: Failed second GitOps manifest after first successfully changes atlas-api.
decisions.teaching_design_validation_plan: Use dedicated local repo with two files; assert first side effect and recorded LastError.
decisions.rationale_classification: editorial inference; no author motivation attributed

decisions.title: Leases, cancellation and fencing
decisions.context: Only one active controller should own shared mutations.
decisions.observed_implementation: PostgresElector holds a session advisory lock and monitors cancellation; default server does not instantiate it.
decisions.alternatives: transaction locks, expiring durable leases with fencing epochs
decisions.inferred_costs: Cancellation and connection release need real-session review; pool reuse may preserve session lock ownership.
decisions.failure_scenario: Old controller continues actions while another believes it acquired leadership.
decisions.boundary: Lease package and default binary HA are separate; mutex tests do not prove DB behavior.
decisions.teaching_design_validation_plan: Two-session test checks cancellation, unlock/reacquire, connection identity and callback shutdown.
decisions.rationale_classification: editorial inference; no author motivation attributed

decisions.title: Admission, quota and enforcement
decisions.context: Intent should be rejected before exceeding policy or budget.
decisions.observed_implementation: Admission validates service requests; quota aggregates desired declared resources. AgentTask lacks resource requirements; adapter limit support is not enough.
decisions.alternatives: measure actual utilization only or enforce on every mutation with durable reservation
decisions.inferred_benefits: Early stable errors and bounded declared intent.
decisions.inferred_costs: Declared accounting can diverge from placement and physical Docker enforcement.
decisions.failure_scenario: Saturated node accepts intent that declared quota permits, but runtime receives zero limits.
decisions.boundary: No CPU/memory enforcement without complete field propagation.
decisions.teaching_design_validation_plan: Trace API→service→taskDTO→ContainerSpec→HostConfig, then compare active and direct adapter tests.
decisions.rationale_classification: editorial inference; no author motivation attributed
